title: Define leased cluster jobs and atomic local control storage
description:
Purpose: isolated ground/local M5 job domain and private control persistence, not public routes. Prerequisites: accepted M4 immutable draft command/run manifest and all-six specifications; public cloud integration remains gated. Allowed new analysis/apricity_analyze/cluster_jobs.py and test_cluster_jobs.py only; no server/browser/CDK/schema dependencies, no model changes, no automatic publication, no Kanbus/git/deploy actions by Terra. Root owns integration and security boundary.

Contract: request {requestId,embeddingSpace,preset,params:{neighbors,minClusterSize,minSamples},corpusRevision?}; strict keys/types, approved embedding space and broad/useful/fine presets. Integers exclude bool: neighbors2..200,minimum cluster size2..500,minimum samples1..100. Validation before persistence. Explicit server-trusted curator context required for enqueue/read/list/retry/draft status; browser-supplied role cannot be an authorization source. Worker methods require distinct injected trusted service identity; no guest controls. Root wires identities later. Idempotent requestId is scoped to requesting actor: identical normalized request reuses same job, conflicting request returns conflict. Job contains jobId/request/requestedBy,attempt,revision,history,queuedAt and state queued|running|failed|draft; published transition excluded.

Atomic private local store uses lock + atomic replace, safe root/keys, no symlink traversal, no ordinary publicly-readable Job model. Offline leaves queued visibly; no scheduling execution on enqueue. claim one queued job or expired running lease atomically with new unpredictable token,workerId and10minute expiry. Racing workers only one wins; renewal/completion/failure require correct worker/token/revision and unexpired lease. Old token after reclaimed lease cannot mutate. Completion attaches an existing validated immutable draft run reference, not arbitrary URL/path or published pointer. Failure retains structured sanitized code/message/retryable + history and releases lease. Retry increments attempt, appends previous failure history, requeues retryable failed jobs idempotently using explicit retry requestId. Existing published runs/pointers untouched in every transition.

Observability: explicit queued/running/error/draft state and revision/timestamps, no fake progress/completion; failed storage/CAS/safe-path operations structured retryable errors. No logging embeddings/audio/raw secrets. Deterministic clock/token fixtures test bounds/null/unknown types, invalid/guest/no writes, duplicate/conflicting requests, offline queue, multiprocessing claim race, renew/expiry/reclaim, stale token/revision, failed/retry history, draft completion guard and preserve published pointer, interruption/atomic replacement and unsafe roots/keys. Gherkin Offline queue and worker lease plus Retry and draft preview stories drive tests; binding integration follows in parent packet.

Verification: PYTHONPATH=analysis analysis/.venv/bin/python -m pytest analysis/tests/test_cluster_jobs.py -q; existing cluster_run tests remain green. RED first, no skipped worker/auth claims. Handoff exact contracts, diff, RED/GREEN counts, concurrency evidence and unimplemented transport/worker/publication limitations. Supervisor reruns/lands child only; do not call M5 complete.

comments.text: Supervisor review found contract gaps before acceptance: completion test only exercises a missing draft, not a valid matching immutable run; private lease expiry bookkeeping leaks in curator responses; preset arrays raise raw TypeError; storage interruptions escape as raw OSError; failure includes arbitrary caller text without structured code/safe message; retries remember only the latest actor request ID. Returning child for RED-first corrections and complete observable coverage. Allowed integration expansion: .github/workflows/ci.yml plus analysis/tests/test_semantic_ci.py to register the new job test explicitly, with root owning those two files. No publication or trusted transport expansion.
